correctness.rationale: Definitions and cutoff boundaries specify inclusive Hamming VR complexes. All 5,949 nonempty scale-two faces are generated from pairwise distances, all 2,951 matching pairs are legitimate codimension-one incidences, the full 27,189-edge Morse orientation is topologically sorted without cycles, and critical dimensions are one zero-cell plus 46 three-cells, proving the integral wedge using discrete Morse theory. At scale one each of 27 edge-disjoint coordinate triangles has a free edge, leaving a connected 54-edge graph (rank 28); scale zero and three are immediate. Mod-2 ranks provide independent finite corroboration but are not used to assert integral torsion freedom; the Morse CW proof supplies that.

value.rationale: The metric space is the smallest equal-alphabet three-coordinate Hamming cube beyond two-valued-factor theorems; its scale-two Rips complex is exactly the first all-three-K3 instance of the independently motivated published Conjecture 26 (arxiv:2307.12401). Resolving that specific proposed 46-sphere homotopy type is not merely an arbitrary table entry or textbook deduction, and the complete integer-scale Rips persistence barcode adds a canonical topological invariant unavailable from the conjectural homology formula alone. No extrapolation to larger alphabet sizes is claimed.
